USB_DP routes 36.04mm and USB_DM 42.27mm — 6.23mm of intra-pair skew against a 3.8mm budget (USB 2.0, ~150ps on FR-4). Length-match the pair or shorten the longer leg
USB_DP_CONN routes 24.44mm and USB_DM_CONN 20.35mm — 4.10mm of intra-pair skew against a 3.8mm budget (USB 2.0, ~150ps on FR-4). Length-match the pair or shorten the longer leg

USB_DP/USB_DM run within 0.60mm of each other (4x the 0.15mm trace) for only 6% of the run — a differential pair should travel together (widest gap 10.86mm). The pipeline's pair pass (circuitpy.diffpair) either could not route this pair or was switched off; its report says which. Review the pair before ordering

USB_DP_CONN/USB_DM_CONN run within 0.60mm of each other (4x the 0.15mm trace) for only 30% of the run — a differential pair should travel together (widest gap 3.02mm). The pipeline's pair pass (circuitpy.diffpair) either could not route this pair or was switched off; its report says which. Review the pair before ordering

25% of USB_DP's run has ground copper on the opposite layer within 0.5mm. A differential pair needs a continuous return path under it or its impedance is undefined and its return current goes wherever it can. Pour ground on the free layer under the pair
U2's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin VIN is 9.7mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (1 pin(s) are further)
U3's nearest decoupling capacitor to pin IOVDD3 is 6.1mm away; the loop inductance is what does the work, so keep it inside 5mm (2 pin(s) are further)
2 signal(s) leave the board through J1 with no ESD clamp on them (J1.A5, J1.B5). A finger on a connector is several kilovolts
U2 dissipates 0.23W at 134mA and sits about 59 degC junction, 66 degC inside the limit
